tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the server directory. Results include measured timestamps and the server page URL. Ranked by checks passed. These are automated measurements, not a rating.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Return one server's metadata, status, latency p50 and p95, checks, and tool list, with measured timestamps and the server page URL.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find servers whose measured tools match a capability. Results are grouped by server and include page URLs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List industry and function categories and how many servers are in each.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Return the latest probe outcome for one server, with the measured timestamp and the server page URL.
